title: assessment
description: One assessor's independent scoring of a set of candidates (designs, options, proposals, vendors, strategies) against a fixed rubric. Each assessor produces one of these in a separate session without seeing any other assessor's scores, which is why 'independent' is const true: a document written with another assessment in context is a reconciliation, which is the manager role's job. Every criterion is scored 1 (worst) to 5 (best) in the same direction of travel, so a 'risk' criterion scored 5 means the lowest risk. The rubric (criterion names) is fixed by the task that asks for the assessment, not by this schema.

assessor_role.description: The role id (config/routing.yaml) that wrote this.

independent.description: The assessor did not see any other assessor's scores or reasoning.

subject.description: What was assessed, e.g. 'storage backend options A-C'.

rubric.description: The criteria every candidate is scored on, as the task fixed them.

ranking.description: Candidate ids best first. Must list exactly the candidates scored above.

abstentions.description: Criteria this assessor considers outside its competence, with the reason. Honest abstention beats an invented score.

criteria.description: criterion name -> score 1..5; every rubric criterion unless listed under abstentions.

reasoning.description: Why these scores, referring to specific properties of the candidate.

evidence.description: Finding ids, file paths or measurements the scores lean on.
